method: Hand review of design/parity/evidence/<row>/comparison.png (reference, built, pixelmatch diff) against Material Design 3 component anatomy and the checked-in reference.

primitives.finding: Reference: one card per version with date chip, code name and category chips (ADDED/FIXED/CHANGED); built: rows with a generic 'Changed' chip and no code name.
Reference uses chips (All time / 90 days / year / 2 years); built uses three dropdowns.
Export Markdown and copy actions present.
Built states 'Completion commit unavailable' for the pending release honestly.

defects.summary: Version card anatomy: category chips and code names missing; date presets are dropdowns
